dict.string: SUBQUERY(extensionItems, $item, $item.attachments.@count > 0 AND SUBQUERY($item.attachments, $p, ANY $p.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.data" OR ANY $p.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.url").@count == $item.attachments.@count).@count == extensionItems.@count
